title: Harmonious Tunisian Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew from Tunisia, made with harmonious notes of spices and a kick of chilli. This dish is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chilli, cumin, and coriander. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
